ORDINANCE XI OF 1984
ORDINANCE XI OF 1984
SUPPRESSION OF TERRORIST ACTIVITIES (SPECIAL COURTS) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Suppression of Terrorist Activities
(Special Courts) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 5th April, 1984]
No. F. 17 (1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and commencement. (1) This Ordinance may be called
the Suppression of Terrorist Activities (Special Courts) (Amendment) Ordi nance,
1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Suppression of Terrorist Activities Special Courts Amendment Ordinance 1984
sections.description:
Amendment of section 4, Act XV of 1975

ORDINANCE XI OF 1984
ORDINANCE XI OF 1984
SUPPRESSION OF TERRORIST ACTIVITIES (SPECIAL COURTS) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Suppression of Terrorist Activities
(Special Courts) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 5th April, 1984]
No. F. 17 (1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 4, Act XV of 1975.--In the Suppression of
Terrorist Activities (Special Courts) Art, 1975 (XV of 1975), in section 4, in
subsection (1), in the proviso, for the full-stop at the end a colon shall be
substituted and thereafter the following second proviso shall be added, namely
:-
"Provided
further that the Government constituting a Special Court may, by notification
in the official Gazette, direct that the Special Court shall have jurisdiction
to try only such persons who have committed scheduled offences as may be
specified in the notification."
